newsitem.title: Belgium: Belgian police find more body parts in sacks.
newsitem.headline: Belgian police find more body parts in sacks.

text.p: Belgian police on the trail of a serial killer said on Saturday they had found three more plastic rubbish sacks containing body parts near the southern town of Mons.
Police have previously found bin bags containing the surgically severed body parts of four women in the same area.

The three bags found on Saturday-- one containing a head, another a leg and another a foot -- were discovered alongside a road in the town of Havre, a Mons police officer told Reuters. Belgian radio said they were originally spotted by a passer-by.
Police have so far found at least nine rubbish sacks containing body parts since the chance discovery last month of bags containing arms and legs in a ditch next to the Brussels-Paris railway line.
The new discovery appeared to be related to the others, but no other details were yet available about the identity of the body, the police officer said.

Police have said the other remains belonged to four Caucasian women. The Mons public prosecutor has said the killings appear to be the work of one person, noting the precise and identical way in which the bodies had been cut up.
